summary: Webhook callback_query ingest is correct and idiomatic. Typed CallbackQuery DTO mirrors the module's record+@JsonIgnoreProperties convention; dispatch branch is placed before the message-fallback (required because callback_query updates have top-level message==null); bot-resolve, logEvent* helpers, and LinkedHashMap-for-nulls follow existing handleStart/logEventCommandStart patterns. resolveUpdateKind correctly keeps the callback_query classification only for the bot-missing degrade path.

findings.finding: Branch ordering, event-before-flip, and error-isolation are all preserved; advanceOnCallback runs inside the existing try/catch(Throwable) with no extra local swallow.
callback_query null-check converted from JsonNode !isNull() to typed-record null check, hoisted above the JsonNode block; remaining opaque slots untouched.
